The terms the DPI-H for Health workshop's policy-maker track hands every table, in plain language. The definitions are the handout's own words ([the handout, PDF](dpi-h-glossary-policy-maker-track.pdf)). Each term links to the same concept in the [DPI-H Reference Architecture](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/dpi-h-ra/index.html) glossary (smart-ra) and the Digital Transformation Handbook for Primary Health Care glossary (dth-phc), where they have one.

*same as*: both glossaries mean the same thing. *close to*: nearly the same. *covers*: this term covers several of theirs. *related*: it only touches theirs. Every term is a candidate until a person adopts it.

### Infrastructure and architecture

| Term | Definition | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-digital-public-infrastructure"></a>**Digital public infrastructure (DPI)** | Shared, government-stewarded systems, such as ID, payments and data exchange, that many services reuse. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: digital-public-infrastructure](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/digital-public-infrastructure/) |
| <a id="term-dpi-for-health"></a>**DPI for health (DPI-H)** | The shared health layer: registries, health record, terminology and decision support, built once and used by many programmes. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: health-digital-public-infrastructure](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/health-digital-public-infrastructure/) |

| <a id="term-decision-support-engine"></a>**Decision support engine** | Applies guideline logic, for example to work out which vaccine dose is due next. |  | close to [DPI-H RA: computable-decision-support-engine](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/computable-decision-support-engine/)<br/>related [DTH-PHC: decision-support-system](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/decision-support-system/)<br/>related [DTH-PHC: decision-support-logic](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/decision-support-logic/) |

| <a id="term-health-management-information-system"></a>**Health management information system (HMIS)** | Aggregate reporting and analytics, such as DHIS2. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: health-management-information-system](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/health-management-information-system/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: health-management-information-system](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/health-management-information-system/) |

### Standards and specifications

| Term | Definition | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-standard-vs-specification"></a>**Standard vs specification** | A standard is a general rulebook (FHIR). A specification says exactly how to apply it to one use case (the ICVP IG). |  | related [DPI-H RA: open-standards](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/open-standards/)<br/>related [DTH-PHC: interoperability-standards](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/interoperability-standards/) |
| <a id="term-smart-guidelines"></a>**SMART Guidelines** | WHO's path from narrative guidelines to digital content that is standards-based, machine-readable, adaptive, requirements-based and testable. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: smart-guidelines](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/smart-guidelines/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: smart-guidelines](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/smart-guidelines/) |
| <a id="term-smart-levels"></a>**SMART levels L1–L5** | L1 narrative guideline · L2 DAK · L3 machine-readable FHIR IG · L4 reference software · L5 dynamic, data-driven use. |  | related [DPI-H RA: smart-guidelines](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/smart-guidelines/) |
| <a id="term-digital-adaptation-kit"></a>**Digital adaptation kit (DAK)** | Software-neutral L2 content: personas, workflows, core data dictionary, decision logic, indicators and requirements. | 1, 3 | same as [DPI-H RA: digital-adaptation-kit](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/digital-adaptation-kit/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: digital-adaptation-kits](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/digital-adaptation-kits/) |
| <a id="term-core-data-set"></a>**Core data set** | The elements a country agrees to record for a use case, each mapped to standard codes. Also called a minimum data set. | 3 | related [DPI-H RA: national-health-data-dictionary](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/national-health-data-dictionary/)<br/>related [DTH-PHC: data-dictionary](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/data-dictionary/) |
| <a id="term-hl7-fhir"></a>**HL7 FHIR (FHIR)** | Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources. The main standard for exchanging health data through APIs. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: fast-healthcare-interoperability-resources](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/fast-healthcare-interoperability-resources/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: fast-healthcare-interoperability-resources](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/fast-healthcare-interoperability-resources/) |
| <a id="term-implementation-guide"></a>**Implementation guide (IG)** | A FHIR specification for one use case: profiles, codes and tests. It can be adopted rather than authored. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: implementation-guide](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/implementation-guide/) |
| <a id="term-profile"></a>**Profile** | A FHIR resource tailored to a use case, for example by making some fields required. |  |  |
| <a id="term-international-patient-summary"></a>**International Patient Summary (IPS)** | A standard minimal health summary, including immunizations, readable across borders. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: international-patient-summary](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-patient-summary/) |
| <a id="term-international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis"></a>**International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis (ICVP)** | The "yellow card". The digital ICVP is its signed, verifiable form. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis/) |
| <a id="term-international-health-regulations"></a>**International Health Regulations (IHR)** | International Health Regulations (2005), amended in 2024. The legal basis for the ICVP and other cross-border health documents. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: international-health-regulations](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-health-regulations/) |
| <a id="term-snomed-ct"></a>**SNOMED CT** | Clinical terminology. Use needs a licence, managed at national level; licensing is a national decision. | 3 | same as [DPI-H RA: snomed-ct](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/snomed-ct/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: snomed-ct](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/snomed-ct/) |
| <a id="term-international-classification-of-diseases"></a>**International Classification of Diseases (ICD)** | WHO's classification; ICD-11 is the current version. |  | same as [DTH-PHC: international-classification-of-diseases](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/international-classification-of-diseases/)<br/>covers [DPI-H RA: international-classification-of-diseases-11th-revision](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/international-classification-of-diseases-11th-revision/)<br/>covers [DTH-PHC: international-classification-of-diseases-11](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/international-classification-of-diseases-11/) |
| <a id="term-logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes"></a>**Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC)** | Codes for laboratory tests and observations. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/logical-observation-identifiers-names-and-codes/) |
| <a id="term-openehr"></a>**openEHR** | An open standard for clinical data models (archetypes), often used to store records alongside FHIR for exchange. |  |  |
| <a id="term-conformance"></a>**Conformance** | Proof that a system implements a specification correctly, usually by passing a test suite. |  |  |

### Trust, credentials and wallets

| Term | Definition | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-verifiable-credential"></a>**Verifiable credential (VC)** | A digitally signed statement, such as a vaccination record, that anyone can check is genuine and unaltered. |  |  |
| <a id="term-issuer-holder-verifier"></a>**Issuer · holder · verifier** | The three roles: who signs the credential, who keeps it, and who checks it. | 4 |  |
| <a id="term-digital-signature"></a>**Digital signature** | A cryptographic seal made with the issuer's private key. Verifiers check it with the matching public key. |  |  |
| <a id="term-public-key-infrastructure"></a>**Public key infrastructure (PKI)** | The keys, certificates and rules that make digital signatures trustworthy. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: public-key-infrastructure](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/public-key-infrastructure/) |
| <a id="term-trust-anchor"></a>**Trust anchor** | The national authority whose key vouches for the health sector's signers. | 4 |  |
| <a id="term-trust-list"></a>**Trust list** | A published list of keys accepted as valid issuers. The GDHCN shares these between countries. |  |  |
| <a id="term-global-digital-health-certification-network"></a>**Global Digital Health Certification Network (GDHCN)** | WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network. A trust network so countries can verify each other's health documents. Countries onboard per use case. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: global-digital-health-certification-network](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/global-digital-health-certification-network/) |
| <a id="term-digital-wallet"></a>**Digital wallet** | An app where a person holds their credentials. A signed paper QR code can play the same role. |  |  |
| <a id="term-digital-documentation-of-covid-19-certificates"></a>**Digital Documentation of COVID-19 Certificates (DDCC)** | WHO's earlier specification; much of its approach carries into the digital ICVP. |  |  |
| <a id="term-health-certificate-identifier"></a>**Health certificate identifier (HCID)** | The unique ID of an issued certificate. | 3 |  |
| <a id="term-consent"></a>**Consent** | A person's permission for their data to be used or shared. Rules for minors and dependants differ by country. |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Testing and convergence

| Term | Definition | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-sandbox"></a>**Sandbox** | A shared test environment with sample data where systems can try exchanges safely. |  |  |
| <a id="term-test-suite"></a>**Test suite** | Automated checks of a system against a specification. ITB, the Interoperability Test Bed, is an open tool used for this. |  |  |
| <a id="term-interoperability-lab"></a>**Interoperability lab** | A standing national or regional facility for conformance testing and building local skills. |  |  |
| <a id="term-connectathon"></a>**Connectathon** | An event where teams test real systems against a specification together. It exposes gaps fast and builds skills. | 5 |  |
| <a id="term-convergence-workshop"></a>**Convergence workshop** | AeHIN's method for aligning a ministry and its partners behind one national architecture and investment plan. |  |  |
| <a id="term-openfn"></a>**OpenFN** | An open-source integration tool used to connect legacy systems and migrate them to standards. |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Governance, planning and financing

| Term | Definition | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-digital-health-strategy"></a>**Digital health strategy** | The national vision and priorities for digital health. |  |  |
| <a id="term-blueprint"></a>**Blueprint** | The target design for the national system and how its parts fit together. |  | close to [DPI-H RA: enterprise-architecture](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/enterprise-architecture/)<br/>close to [DTH-PHC: enterprise-architecture](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/enterprise-architecture/) |
| <a id="term-costed-investment-plan"></a>**Costed investment plan** | A prioritised, costed roadmap from today's systems to the blueprint. |  |  |
| <a id="term-digital-implementation-investment-guide"></a>**Digital Implementation Investment Guide (DIIG)** | WHO Digital Implementation Investment Guide. Steps to plan, cost and integrate digital health investments. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: digital-implementation-investment-guide](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/digital-implementation-investment-guide/)<br/>same as [DTH-PHC: digital-implementation-investment-guide](https://litlfred.github.io/dth-phc/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dth-phc/dth-phc/digital-implementation-investment-guide/) |
| <a id="term-technical-working-group"></a>**Technical working group (TWG)** | Coordinates standards and architecture decisions across government and partners. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: technical-working-group](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/technical-working-group/) |
| <a id="term-decision-rights"></a>**Decision rights** | Who has authority over architecture, standards, the core data set and the trust anchor. | 4 |  |
| <a id="term-procurement-conditions"></a>**Procurement conditions** | Requirements written into tenders, such as conformance to the national IG, that steer what suppliers build. |  |  |
| <a id="term-total-cost-of-ownership"></a>**Total cost of ownership (TCO)** | Build costs plus running costs over a system's whole life. | 6 | same as [DPI-H RA: total-cost-of-ownership](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/total-cost-of-ownership/) |
| <a id="term-vendor-lock-in"></a>**Vendor lock-in** | Dependence on one supplier because data formats or interfaces are closed. |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Immunization

| Term | Definition | Sheet | Also defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="term-expanded-programme-on-immunization"></a>**Expanded Programme on Immunization (EPI)** | The national immunization programme. |  |  |
| <a id="term-adverse-event-following-immunization"></a>**Adverse event following immunization (AEFI)** | Any health problem after vaccination, reported for safety monitoring. |  | same as [DPI-H RA: adverse-events-following-immunization](https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/glossary/instance/dpi-h-ra/dpi-h-ra/adverse-events-following-immunization/) |
| <a id="term-dose-number-and-series"></a>**Dose number and series** | Which dose this is, out of how many in the schedule. Needed to work out what is due next. |  |  |
| <a id="term-batch-number"></a>**Batch number** | Identifies the production batch of a vaccine. Needed for recalls and safety checks. |  |  |
| <a id="term-logistics-management-information-system"></a>**Logistics management information system (LMIS)** | Tracks vaccine stock; the cold chain keeps vaccines at the right temperature. |  |  |
{: .grid }

### Sources

The handout: *DPI-H for Health Workshop, Policy-maker track, Glossary: Terms You Will Hear* (2 sides), which cites the WHO/ITU Reference Architecture for DPI-H (Draft v1.0), WHO SMART Guidelines, the digital ICVP specification and the WHO DIIG. The SKOS scheme is `glossary/dpi-h-policy-track.glossary.json`. The dth-phc glossary is linked where litlfred/dth-phc publishes it, until it moves to WorldHealthOrganization/dth-phc.
